package echo

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func TestProbeEmpty(t *testing.T) {
	e := New()
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
	req.Header.Set("Accept-Encoding", "gzip")
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	c := e.NewContext(req, rec)
	h := func(c Context) error { return nil }
	h2 := func(c Context) error { return c.NoContent(http.StatusNoContent) }
	_ = h2
	_ = h
	fmt.Println("rec code", rec.Code)
}
EOF

package middleware

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4"
)

func TestProbeGzEmpty(t *testing.T) {
	e := echo.New()
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
	req.Header.Set(echo.HeaderAcceptEncoding, "gzip")
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	c := e.NewContext(req, rec)
	h := Gzip()(func(c echo.Context) error { return nil })
	h(c)
	fmt.Printf("no-write: code=%d body=%q ce=%q ct=%q\n", rec.Code, rec.Body.String(), rec.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentEncoding), rec.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentType))

	req = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
	req.Header.Set(echo.HeaderAcceptEncoding, "gzip")
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	c = e.NewContext(req, rec)
	h = Gzip()(func(c echo.Context) error { return c.NoContent(http.StatusNoContent) })
	h(c)
	fmt.Printf("nocontent: code=%d body=%q ce=%q ct=%q\n", rec.Code, rec.Body.String(), rec.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentEncoding), rec.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentType))
}
EOF
